key_facts: lesion started as a small cutaneous nodule
no history of local trauma or insect bite
unremarkable personal, past, and family histories
6 × 6-cm protuberant, thick-walled, and well-defined red tumor
nontender, firm-to-hard nodule inside the tumor
multilocular spaces below the epidermis on pathological examination
solid tumor in the deep dermis with a chalky-white cut surface and lobulated appearance

raw.rationale: The presence of a firm-to-hard nodule inside the tumor, multilocular spaces below the epidermis, and a solid tumor in the deep dermis with a chalky-white cut surface and lobulated appearance on pathological examination are characteristic of pilomatricoma.

rejected.label: Bullous pilomatricoma
rejected.why: While bullous pilomatricoma could be considered due to the bullalike appearance, the primary characteristics described align more closely with classic pilomatricoma features.

rejected.label: Epidermal inclusion cyst
rejected.why: The presence of a hard nodule inside the tumor and the specific pathological findings do not align with typical features of an epidermal inclusion cyst, which usually presents as a simple cystic structure without a hard nodule.
